◆ synthIcpTrimVco1

rlUInt8_t rlRfApllSynthBwControl_t::synthIcpTrimVco1

Synth ICP trim code
.

Note
: In xWR294x/xWR254x/xWR2x4xECO/xWR2x4xP devices, this field sets the SYNTH ICP trim code for VCO1. In other supported devices, this field sets
the common SYNTH ICP trim code for both VCO1 and VCO2.
Default value in xWR294x/xWR254x/xWR2x4xECO/xWR2x4xP = 0x1
